definitions.gloss: secret photography; candid shot; taking photos without permission
definitions.explanation: the act of photographing or filming someone without their knowledge or consent

examples.japanese: {盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧です。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Secret photography on trains has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出回|でまわ}って→出回る：11736_demawaru⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{騒|さわ}ぎ→騒ぎ：02827_sawagi⟧になった。
examples.english: Secretly taken photos of the celebrity circulated online and caused a big uproar.

notes:
Refers to taking photographs or video of someone without their knowledge or consent. In Japan, this is taken very seriously as both a social taboo and a legal offense. Since 2023, Japan has strengthened laws against voyeuristic photography under the revised Penal Code.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take secret photos
- {盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧: secretly taken photograph
- {盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: secretly taken video
- {盗|ぬす}み{撮|ど}り⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: harm from secret photography

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盗撮|とうさつ}→盗撮：20492_tousatsu⟧: voyeuristic photography — a more formal/legal term for the same act
- {隠|かく}し{撮|ど}り: hidden camera filming — often used for hidden camera shows or pranks as well
- ⟦{無断|むだん}→無断：13382_mudan⟧⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: unauthorized filming — broader term covering any photography without permission
